title: Product Type dropdown offers exactly three options with Parts & Service as the default
preconditions: 1. You are on the report with no remembered settings.
steps: 1. Find the "Product Type" dropdown in the toolbar and read its default value.
2. Open it and read the options.
expected: 1. A "Product Type" dropdown is visible in the toolbar.
2. It offers exactly three options: "Parts & Service," "Parts only," "Service only."
3. "Parts & Service" is the default on first load.
